inputs: registry rows (path, disposition, reason, decision, testCategory)
git-tracked audited files with fs imports
classes: row disposition deferred-migration -> rejected by guard as unresolved
registry has 0 deferred-migration rows after migration/exception
dispositionCounts mirrors rows exactly (no deferred key; repo-contract count consistent)
remaining exception rows (os-guarantee, standalone-script, repo-contract, ...) keep reason+decision -> accepted
guideline source and mirror no list deferred-migration and stay byte-equal
migrated production/test file: fs import gone -> its row removed (stale-entry check) - oracle is the guard itself over the real repo
row disposition outside the guideline set {os-guarantee,standalone-script,type-contract,boundary-adapter,repo-contract,in-flight-churn} (e.g. unknown "deferred") -> rejected by guard and by registry
effort-based reason/decision (/effort|not migrated in this PR|delivery stage/i) -> never accepted in any row

in-scope production file with ordinary IO relabeled as an accepted exception (any keyword-matching reason, non-empty observedOperations) -> must have no row unless its path is in the pinned reviewed exception allowlist -> rejected
type-contract/boundary-adapter/in-flight-churn rows stay inside their boundary (type-only reason; adapter path; Scope Limit zones) -> accepted

in-scope test file with ordinary IO relabeled as an accepted exception (keyword reason, non-empty observedOperations) -> must have no row unless its path is in the pinned reviewed test-exception allowlist -> rejected

out-of-scope (non-editable) deferred test relabeled as os-guarantee/repo-contract with a keyword reason -> path must be in the pinned reviewed out-of-scope set (6 former-deferred paths listed with real-boundary evidence) and resolve only to os-guarantee/repo-contract -> else rejected
interactions: guard UNRESOLVED x registry rows: dropping deferred-migration rows while guard still accepts it would leave deferral re-addable -> both witnesses needed
registry counts x row removal: removing rows requires regenerating dispositionCounts

relabel bypass: deferred-migration/ordinary-IO production OR test row renamed to os-guarantee/repo-contract with a keyword reason -> path not in the pinned allowlist -> W-r0-1-exception-evidence fails; C-r0-1-relabel-fixture proves the discriminator for both

out-of-SCOPE former-deferred test rows x GREEN fixScope: GREEN cannot edit those 6 files, so it can only relabel their rows; pinned set + real-boundary disposition witness are the only discriminators (AC3/AC6)
